artworks.title: Catafalque for the Funeral of Giulio Thieni, Marquis of Scandiano
artworks.artist: Giovanni Luigi Valesio, after Nicolaus de Monte
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate architectural design with sculptures and symbols. It features a tall structure, possibly a monument or ceremonial altar. The base includes ornamental features like carved figures and patterns. Statuettes in niches adorn the structure, including a skeleton. At the top is a small sculpture with pointed spires resembling Gothic architecture, each topped with flames. Decorative elements like shields, crosses, and text panels are present, emphasizing heraldry and textual messaging. The detailed drawing suggests it may be a plan for an architectural project or ceremonial construct.

artworks.title: Catafalque for an Unknown Woman Named Maria
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 31.7 × 22.5 cm (12 1/2 × 8 7/8 in.) trimmed within plate mark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate altar adorned with figures and symbols. The structure includes a skeletal figure at the top holding a scythe and an hourglass, flanked by two winged figures holding trumpets. Below, there is a grand arch with a coat of arms and candles. Inside the arch, there is a cloth-draped structure surrounded by angels and candles. The foreground features standing female figures, cherubs, carvings, and candleholders. The word "MARIA" is central to the scene.

artworks.title: The Ruins of the Colosseum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image displays the interior of an ancient stone structure. Arched openings with heavy stone blocks frame the scene, leading to more arches and columns in the distance. The horizon is obscured by the architecture. The work features detailed line work, with cross-hatching and parallel lines providing shading and texture for the stone. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white to emphasize contrast and detail. The ground is rocky and uneven, leading towards a brighter area in the distance.

artworks.title: Palazzo Maggiore (Imperial Palace on the Palatine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image depicts an old building with intricate arches, brickwork, and detailed lines. In the background, there are rolling hills and remains of old structures. The style is characterized by variations in hatching and cross-hatching for shading and texture, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily black and white, emphasizing details and light and shadow. The ancient structure stands out against the background.

artworks.title: Antonine Baths, or Baths of Caracalla
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image features ancient architectural ruins with large archways dominating the scene. The perspective shows a view through the arches with a distant space beyond. The detailed etching technique is evident in the intricate line work and hatching, depicting textures and shadows, especially in the stone and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white, emphasizing contrast. Foliage grows atop some structures, adding texture and depth.

artworks.title: Künstlers Erdenwallen (The Artist’s Earthly Pilgrimage)
artworks.medium: six lithographs on chine appliqué on wove paper, in original lithograph wrapper on light blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E.M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate border of swirling lines and ornate shapes surrounding text in the center. The scene includes a variety of elements: a birdcage and an egg on the left, a seated figure with a rabbit-ear headdress at the top, and a figure with a horn and swirling vines on the right. In the middle, an anthropomorphic character with wings and trumpets is featured. The components form a collage that combines abstract elements with imaginative representations connected to mythical and earthly inspirations.

artworks.title: Lion
artworks.artist: Marcus de Bye, after Paulus Potter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Harvey
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion in a natural landscape. The lion has a mane, teeth showing, a muscular body, and a curved tail with a tuft at the end. The setting includes trees, rocks, and mountains in the background. The drawing uses linework and shading to depict the lion and its environment.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude with Raised Right Hand
artworks.medium: graphite with black and white chalk on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Alan Brown
artworks.description: The image shows a seated male figure reclining slightly backward. His left arm is raised and bent, holding onto something above, while his right arm rests on an object beside him. His facial features are detailed, with a neutral expression and a slightly downward gaze. He has short, neatly combed hair with a side parting. The man is depicted in the nude, emphasizing his muscular form with detailed shading. He is seated on a cushioned surface, and the background is simple. The drawing is done in pencil on paper, with shading for depth.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: Raphael Morghen, after Leonardo da Vinci
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Alan Brown
artworks.description: This print shows thirteen men seated at a long, horizontal dining table covered with a tablecloth. The upper body of each individual is visible, and some of their legs can be seen below the table. The central man has long hair and a composed expression on his face, and he is looking downward with his hands outstretched. The men on either side of the central man are shown in a range of overlapping postures, with some leaning across each other or gesturing with their hands. Most of the men have beards, except for a few who have clean-shaven faces. Their hairstyles vary, from long and wavy to short and curly. The clothing consists of loose, draped garments resembling robes. The table is laid with various dishes and cups, and a few men hold objects like a knife or bread. The background features three large windows that frame a distant landscape view. The walls of the room are decorated with geometric patterns, and the ceiling is high.

artworks.title: Fern
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large gray fern leaf on a textured, light beige background. The color palette includes shades of gray for the leaf and off-white to beige for the background. The fern leaf is positioned with its stem from the middle of the bottom edge towards the upper left, taking up most of the image space with its detailed fronds.

artworks.title: Notre-Dame
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the Cathedral of Notre Dame with a slightly elevated perspective, showcasing its grand architecture. The cathedral dominates the scene with its twin towers rising against the sky. Details of the intricate stonework and gothic detailing are captured with crisp and precise brushstrokes. The sepia color palette gives the image an old-world, timeless quality. A cobblestone street leads up to the cathedral's entrance, flanked by buildings on the left and trees on the right. In the distance, the facades and archways of Notre Dame create depth and grandeur.

artworks.title: Rooftops
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image is a rooftop view of a dense urban area, likely taken from an elevated position. The horizon shows a line of buildings creating an uneven skyline with chimneys and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic with tones of black, white, and gray. Closest to us are rooftops with weather-worn tiles and chimneys. In the distance, buildings fade into the sky. The style is photographic, utilizing grain and contrast for mood and structure.

artworks.title: Crimean Braves — Men of the Trenches and Battlefields in the Crimea
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three men in military uniforms, seated closely together. Each man is holding a rifle, with a third rifle resting horizontally across their laps. The central figure appears slightly taller and further back than the other two. All three have full beards. The central man wears a fur hat, while the others have shorter hair. They have buttons, sashes, and multiple medals on their chests. Belts and one man's ammunition pouches are visible. The setting seems to be indoors, with a plain backdrop and a fragment of a wall or pillar on the left side.

artworks.title: Manorbier Castle Courtyard, Wales
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a castle courtyard with stone walls and ruins forming the perimeter. The castle's bastions and towers dominate the horizon, with a mix of intact and crumbling structures. Some areas are covered in climbing ivy. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting the stone texture. People can be seen exploring, one with an umbrella. A wooden structure is visible nearby. Light and shadow emphasize the architecture's historical nature against the bright sky.

artworks.title: Study for "Alpine Mastiffs Reanimating a Distressed Traveler" (recto); Study for "Alpine Mastiffs Reanimating a Distressed Traveler" (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) graphite and pen and brown ink on laid paper
b) graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E.M. Gunnarsson Fund

artworks.title: Candélabre du Palais de l’Industrie
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the collection of Jeffrey Hugh Newman
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a wrought iron gate and lamp post in front of a building with arched windows. The gate is adorned with intricate swirling patterns and decorative motifs. A tall lamp post rises at the center, featuring a vintage lantern style. The building in the background has large arched windows, a frieze with classical floral designs, and pilasters.

artworks.title: Halle aux Blés (Intérieur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the collection of Jeffrey Hugh Newman
artworks.description: The image shows a central lamp post surrounded by large sacks. The color scheme is grayscale. In the foreground, a tall ornate lamp post stands amid several bags. In the background, two numbered archways labeled '12' and '14' display stacks of more bags and a clock on the wall to the left. The setting includes a rounded architectural space with a balustrade above and two smaller lamp fixtures on each side of the central archway.

artworks.title: Quai de Montebello
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the collection of Jeffrey Hugh Newman
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with tall buildings lining a cobbled road in a European city. Signs on the buildings read "TABAC" and "DENTISTE." The road leads towards a row of diminishing buildings, with leafless trees in the background. The image is in sepia tones, suggesting an older time period. The buildings feature classic European architectural elements like mansard roofs and shuttered windows.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy seated on a carved wooden chair with ornate upholstery. He is captured in a full-body view, slightly angled as he sits with one leg crossed over the other. His facial expression is neutral, with wide eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. His hair is short, combed neatly, and brown in color. He is dressed in a formal outfit that includes a black jacket over a pinstriped vest, a white collared shirt, and gray trousers, with shiny black shoes on his feet. The boy holds a straw hat with a black ribbon in his right hand, resting on his lap. The background is a simple, muted beige wall with a blue carpet or rug under the chair and small footstool. The year "1856" is written on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Feet Washing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows four men seated or crouching together. The man in the foreground is partially crouching and appears to be performing a task, while the three other men are seated closely next to each other. The man in the middle has a bald head and facial hair, while the men on either side have short, dark hair. All men are wearing long-sleeved shirts with ties; the shirts have light, possibly striped patterns. There is a bowl on the floor, and the man who is crouching is using it for some activity involving his hands. The environment appears to be indoors, with a dimly lit background that suggests a simple, perhaps wooden interior.

artworks.title: Baptismal Scene
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Peter Edwards and Rose Gutfeld
artworks.description: Three individuals stand together in shallow water. They are close to each other, with their bodies visible from below the chest upward. The person in the middle is held by the individuals on either side, forming a small circle with their hands. The central person wears a headwrap, partially shadowing their face, which is turned downward. The two men on the sides have short-cropped hair and are facing the camera. All three individuals are dressed in long-sleeved white garments. The setting is a natural, wooded area, with trees and foliage surrounding them and a stream nearby. The background is softly focused.

artworks.title: Feet Washing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows three women participating in a foot-washing ritual. The women are partially depicted, focusing on their upper bodies and the action of two women washing another woman's foot. They are sitting close to one another with two of them leaning forward to wash. Their faces are partly obscured by shadows. Each woman wears a light-colored headscarf and a white dress. The woman whose foot is being washed sits upright while the others lean over a basin on the floor. The setting is indoors with a wooden background visible, creating an intimate, softly lit atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Girl
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E.M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched portrait of a person's upper body in profile facing left. The individual's head is slightly tilted downwards, and their neck and shoulders are visible. The facial features are delicately etched, with a prominent nose and closed lips. The hair is styled neatly, pulled back and away from the face. There are no specific clothing details visible. The sketch is enclosed within an irregular rectangular form, with shading and cross-hatching around the figure. The background is plain and beige.

artworks.title: The Village Street
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E.M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a village scene with buildings, foliage, and a figure walking along a path. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear perspective. The buildings have steeply pitched roofs and detailed textures. The color palette is sepia-toned. A figure is walking along the path and there are clouds in the sky.
